dining.name: JB's Smokehouse
dining.summary: The chain smokehouse at the park's center — brisket plates in the middle of a Texas barbecue state, held to a fair standard.
description: JB's sits in the tower section and serves the chain's smokehouse menu: sliced brisket, pulled pork, sides. In a state that judges barbecue for a living, expectations should be calibrated to 'good theme-park barbecue' rather than 'Texas barbecue' — and at that calibration it clears.
The indoor seating is a genuine midday asset; the tower section has the park's worst shade, and the smokehouse's air conditioning is the local recovery room.
tips: Claim indoor seating before ordering in July.
App ordering skips the register queue on weekends.
dining.verdict: Fair portions at fair park prices, and the only hot meal at the park worth planning a stop for.

dining.name: Old South Fried Chicken
dining.priceNote: Basket meals in the low-to-mid teens
dining.summary: Fried chicken baskets in the shadiest section of the park — the family consensus stop with real seating.
description: The Old South location serves chicken baskets and sides with indoor seating in the Spain section — the coolest, quietest part of the park at midday. It is the default family lunch: safe food, real tables, shade outside the door.
Portions run theme-park standard; the location is the actual product.
tips: The midday shade hour belongs to Spain — lunch here is the plan that rides the heat.
Comb baskets split well for kids.
dining.verdict: Unremarkable food in the right place at the right time — which at a Texas park in summer is the whole game.

dining.name: Spain Churro Cart
dining.summary: Cinnamon churros in the park's most pleasant section — the classic walking snack done right.
description: The churro cart in Spain is the park's best snack stop by location: hot churros, cinnamon sugar, and a bench under the section's mature trees a few steps away.
The cart's pace is steady all day; the only queue that builds is the pre-close dessert rush.
tips: Buy two — a single churro is a tease.
The shaded benches nearby are the park's best snack seating.
dining.verdict: A theme-park churro in the right setting, which makes it better than the same churro by the front gate.
